video_title: ROOTED S2 EP 1: Nickeil Alexander-Walker | Growth

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on the Hawks' disappointing playoff exit
quotes.excerpt: It was humiliating. It wasn't how we wanted the season to end.
quotes.quote: It was humiliating. It wasn't how we wanted the season to end. It wasn't a good depiction on our team and quite frankly, it wasn't a good depiction on how our season went. Definitely was embarrassing for the world to see that.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on his growth and future motivation
quotes.excerpt: I have another chance to rewrite the story and the way I lost tonight.
quotes.quote: I think the next step is to grow, to learn. I'm extremely excited because I have another chance to rewrite the story and the way I lost tonight, the way we lost, the way I played. It gives me, I always had something to work for, but now it's a little extra fuel in the fire and I'm excited.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on his relationship with his cousins
quotes.excerpt: We just enjoy each other's company and doing different things at the same time.
quotes.quote: We just enjoy each other's company and doing different things at the same time, but sometimes they'll collab and I go crazy together.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on team chemistry and success in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The teams that have a lot of success are actually bonded, connected, in unison.
quotes.quote: It's starting to see around the league, like the teams that have a lot of success are actually bonded, connected, in unison. They all work as one, they all enjoy the process of trying to be good teams together.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on the importance of off-season training
quotes.excerpt: Everyone feels like they had a great summer and they're going to come in and win.
quotes.quote: Everyone feels like they had a great summer and they're going to come in and be the ones to win. But if those teams are going into that thinking and they're making moves and getting better, stuff like this has to be our separator.
